encode_string_to_characters: encode a string into space-separated characters using the Characters BPE encoder
decode_characters_to_string: decode space-separated characters back into the original string using Characters.decode
register_characters_bpe: register the Characters class as a BPE encoder with the name 'characters'
review_characters_encode_decode: review the Characters class encode and decode methods for character-level tokenization
test_characters_roundtrip: test the Characters encoder by encoding then decoding a string to verify roundtrip correctness
